title: 氮化矽低損耗波導
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SiN 低損耗、薄膜應力與吸收頻譜；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine sin low loss, film stress and absorption spectra. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。不同沉積與退火路徑不可互換；低損耗紀錄屬特定波長與製程，不是所有 SiN 元件的保證。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Deposition and annealing routes are not interchangeable; record losses apply to specified wavelength/process, not every SiN device.

stages.title: 材料與頻譜
stages.description: 本階段處理材料與頻譜：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address materials and spectra through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 選定工作頻帶
steps.objective: 建立「選定工作頻帶」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：低損耗需連到特定波長，鍵結吸收與包覆會形成頻譜限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for choose operating band: Low loss is wavelength-specific; bond absorption and cladding limit spectra.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。標記預定波段及可能吸收區。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Mark operating and possible absorption bands. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：標記預定波段及可能吸收區。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Mark operating and possible absorption bands. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：負載 Q 可不經校正直接當內部 Q。本步先檢查「選定工作頻帶」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到低損耗需連到特定波長，鍵結吸收與包覆會形成頻譜限制。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Loaded Q directly equals intrinsic Q. First check whether evidence for choose operating band actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Low loss is wavelength-specific; bond absorption and cladding limit spectra.
steps.check: 交付「選定工作頻帶」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
